= quoted-operators(1)
:doctype: manpage
:manmanual: Conditional comparisons
:mansource: acdc
:revdate: 2026-10-02
:markup: <tag>
:operator-text: a == b != c <= d >= e < f > g

== NAME

quoted-operators - compare quoted operands

== DESCRIPTION

ifeval::["<tag>" == "<tag>"]
Q01 Double-quoted markup matches.
endif::[]

ifeval::['<tag>' == '<tag>']
Q02 Single-quoted markup matches.
endif::[]

ifeval::["a == b != c <= d >= e < f > g" == 'a == b != c <= d >= e < f > g']
Q03 Every embedded operator stays text.
endif::[]

ifeval::["a < b" != "a > b"]
Q04 Unequal strings match.
endif::[]

ifeval::['a < b' < 'b < a']
Q05 Less-than uses string order.
endif::[]

ifeval::["a <= b" <= "a <= b"]
Q06 Less-than-or-equal includes equality.
endif::[]

ifeval::['b > a' > 'a > b']
Q07 Greater-than uses string order.
endif::[]

ifeval::["b >= a" >= "b >= a"]
Q08 Greater-than-or-equal includes equality.
endif::[]

ifeval::["left ] [ right" == 'left ] [ right']
Q09 Brackets remain inside quoted operands.
endif::[]

ifeval::["{markup}" == '<tag>']
Q10 Attribute references compare with literal markup.
endif::[]

ifeval::["{operator-text}" == '{operator-text}']
Q11 Attribute references preserve operator text.
endif::[]

ifeval::["" == '']
Q12 Both quote styles represent the empty string.
endif::[]

ifeval::[" padded < value " == ' padded < value ']
Q13 Inner whitespace remains significant.
endif::[]

ifeval::[   " spaced > value "   ==   ' spaced > value '   ]
Q14 Outer whitespace does not enter the operand.
endif::[]

ifeval::["same < value"=='same < value']
Q15 Comparison spaces are optional.
endif::[]

ifeval::["l'été < demain" == 'l’été < demain']
F01 Different apostrophes must not match.
endif::[]

ifeval::["l'été < demain" == "l'été < demain"]
Q16 The other quote character is literal.
endif::[]

ifeval::['say "hello" > now' == 'say "hello" > now']
Q17 Double quotes inside single quotes stay literal.
endif::[]

ifeval::['naïve < café 🚀' == "naïve < café 🚀"]
Q18 Unicode strings compare across quote styles.
endif::[]

ifeval::["C:\work\[draft] < done\" == 'C:\work\[draft] < done\']
Q19 Backslashes stay literal, including before a closing quote.
endif::[]

ifeval::["10" < '2']
Q20 Quoted numbers compare as strings.
endif::[]

ifeval::["true" == 'true']
Q21 Quoted booleans compare as strings.
endif::[]

ifeval::["1 + 1" == '1 + 1']
Q22 Quoted arithmetic remains text.
endif::[]

ifeval::[2 < 10]
Q23 Unquoted numbers still compare as numbers.
endif::[]

ifeval::[true == true]
Q24 Unquoted booleans retain their meaning.
endif::[]

ifeval::["a < b" == 'a > b']
F02 Unequal strings must not satisfy equality.
endif::[]

ifeval::["same == value" != 'same == value']
F03 Equal strings must not satisfy inequality.
endif::[]

ifeval::['same < value' < "same < value"]
F04 Equal strings must not satisfy less-than.
endif::[]

ifeval::['z <= a' <= "a <= z"]
F05 Reversed strings must not satisfy less-than-or-equal.
endif::[]

ifeval::['same > value' > "same > value"]
F06 Equal strings must not satisfy greater-than.
endif::[]

ifeval::['a >= z' >= "z >= a"]
F07 Reversed strings must not satisfy greater-than-or-equal.
endif::[]

Q25 Content after all conditions remains visible.
